component.name: Wireless
component.summary: Battery and charging status for wireless peripherals

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet that shows the battery level and charging state of wireless mice, keyboards, headsets and gamepads.

Devices are read from the kernel's power supply interface and from BlueZ, so both 2.4 GHz receivers and standard Bluetooth peripherals are covered. Every connected device gets its own icon and percentage in the panel.
